source.download_note: GitHub blob API content is base64; decode to exact source bytes, not the API JSON body
source.patch: Exactly one CLIPModel.from_pretrained call gains local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False, use_safetensors=True. Applied in memory only after both source hashes match reviewed constants.

preprocessing: RGB; torchvision Resize((336,336)) default bilinear; ToTensor; CLIP mean [.48145466,.4578275,.40821073], std [.26862954,.26130258,.27577711]

protocol.model: Author CLIP v2: six experts, rank one, top two, router hidden 256, hybrid true; all parameters frozen
protocol.roles: Existing partition_rows, seed42; only development calibration/evaluation image files are SHA256-verified and read; no train, selection or holdout image reads
protocol.resource_guard: Both --verify-load and --execute take outputs/image_experiments/gpu0-research.lock nonblocking and fail when busy. Default device is CPU. Explicit --device cuda uses physical gpu_index=1 through CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 and logical cuda:0.
protocol.run_status: Evaluation creates an exclusive output directory, writes running status and resolved_config.json, then completed/exit0 or failed/exit1. Existing run directories and their status are never overwritten.
protocol.scores: Author output is softmax[:,1]=p_ai, converted to [1-p_ai,p_ai] without a second sigmoid
protocol.activation: Download and hash assets; safely convert the pinned CLIP bin to safetensors and register its size/hash; explicit --verify-load writes a full-reload/single-batch receipt without enabling evaluation. Bind receipt hash and completed 100-per-cell manifest hash, then separately set status=ready and execution_enabled=true. Invoke --execute manually; never insert this experiment into the four-job queue.

blockers: No full model weights were downloaded or loaded in this preparation task.

The pinned official OpenAI CLIP repository currently has pytorch_model.bin but no model.safetensors. Safe local conversion, tensor equality checks and derived SHA256 registration are required; no pickle/network fallback is implemented.

The author detector pth has not been tested with torch.load(weights_only=True). If its metadata requires unsupported pickle globals, stop for a separately reviewed safe conversion; never retry weights_only=False.
Exact strict key compatibility between the author self-contained inference source and v2 checkpoint is unverified until full reload succeeds; mismatches are errors.
The completed 100-per-cell manifest and full reload receipt remain unbound. The configuration stays disabled.
